lines.text: David grew exhausted fighting the Philistines, and Ishbi-benob, a descendant of Rapha, resolved to kill him.
Joab son of Zeruiah came to David's aid and killed the Philistine, and David's men swore he must never again go to battle.
At Gob, Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, and Elhanan son of Jair killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite.
At Gath, a man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot taunted Israel.
Jonathan the son of David's brother Shimei killed him, and five descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
